requirement_text: System shall integrate with existing University systems such as LDAP for cost-effective administration.
user_story: As a system administrator, I want the system to integrate with existing University systems such as LDAP, so that administration costs less.
technical_task: Connect the system to existing University systems, for example LDAP, to reuse their administration.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing University system such as LDAP, when the system is configured to use it, then the integration works.
Given the integration is in place, when an administrator manages users, then the existing University system is used for it.
rationale: Role assumed: system administrator. "Cost-effective" is not measured; the criteria check only the integration.

requirement_text: User shall be able to create a patient profile.
user_story: As a health worker, I want to create a patient profile, so that I can keep a patient's details.
technical_task: Add a form that creates a patient profile.
acceptance_criteria: Given the profile form, when the user enters patient details and saves, then a patient profile is created.
Given a created patient profile, when the user opens it, then the saved details are shown.
rationale: Role assumed: health worker. The profile fields are not listed.

requirement_text: System shall enforce limitations on duplicate registrations to maintain system integrity.
user_story: As an administrator, I want limits on duplicate registrations, so that the system stays consistent.
technical_task: Detect and limit duplicate registrations.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing registration, when a user tries to register again with the same details, then the duplicate is refused.
Given a new registration with different details, when the user registers, then it is accepted.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. What counts as a duplicate is not defined; the criteria assume identical details.

requirement_text: The HCP can edit the patient according to data format 6.4 with all initial values (except patient MID) defaulting to null possibly and possibly 0 as appropriate.
requirement_text_raw: The HCP can edit the patient according to data format 6.4  with all initial values (except patient MID) defaulting to null possibly and possibly 0 as appropriate.
user_story: As an HCP, I want to edit the patient according to data format 6.4 with initial values defaulting to null, or 0 where appropriate, so that new records start clean.
technical_task: Let the HCP edit the patient following data format 6.4, setting all initial values except the patient MID to null by default, or to 0 where that is appropriate.
acceptance_criteria: Given the HCP edits a patient, when the edit screen opens, then the fields follow data format 6.4.
Given a patient with no entered values, when the edit screen opens, then all initial values except the patient MID default to null, or to 0 where appropriate.
rationale: Role stated: HCP. Which fields default to 0 is not given.

requirement_text: If the time-out expires before the other members have room in their input buffers, any member without room in their input buffer shall be ignored, the packet exchanged, and an IBNF time-out recorded.
requirement_text_raw: If the time-out expires before the other members have room in their input buffers, any member without room in their input buffer shall (3.2.2.6.16) be ignored, the packet exchanged, and an IBNF time-out recorded.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want a member without room in its input buffer to be ignored, the packet exchanged and an IBNF time-out recorded when the time-out expires, so that the exchange completes.
technical_task: When the time-out expires before all members have room in their input buffers, ignore the members lacking room, exchange the packet and record an IBNF time-out.
acceptance_criteria: Given the time-out expires and a member has no room in its input buffer, when the exchange proceeds, then that member is ignored.
Given the time-out has expired, when the packet is exchanged, then an IBNF time-out is recorded.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer.

requirement_text: User shall/will have access to a simple and intuitive user interface designed for ease of use, especially for elderly patients.
rationale: "Simple", "intuitive" and "ease of use" are subjective and not measurable.
clarification_questions: What specific needs of elderly patients must be met?

requirement_text: User can create profiles with health worker information, attaching usernames for identification, and supporting multiple users on a single device.
user_story: As a health worker, I want to create profiles with my information and a username, and share one device with other users, so that each person is identified.
technical_task: Support profiles with health worker information and usernames for identification, and allow multiple users on one device.
acceptance_criteria: Given a health worker, when a profile is created, then the health worker information and a username are saved.
Given one device, when several users create profiles, then each user is identified by their own username.
rationale: Role assumed: health worker.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to access help content in both offline and online modes.
user_story: As a user, I want to open help content both offline and online, so that I can get help without a connection.
technical_task: Provide help content that can be opened with or without an internet connection.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user is online, when the user opens help, then the help content is shown.
Given the user is offline, when the user opens help, then the help content is shown.
rationale: Role assumed: user.

requirement_text: Admin shall be able to manage teams, including creating a unique ID for each team and managing team details.
user_story: As an admin, I want to manage teams with a unique ID for each and editable details, so that teams are kept organized.
technical_task: Provide team management that assigns a unique ID to each team and lets the admin edit team details.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new team, when the admin creates it, then it gets a unique ID.
Given an existing team, when the admin edits its details, then the changes are saved.
rationale: Role stated: admin.

requirement_text: The server shall have at least 500MB of free disk space even if the IDE is already installed.
user_story: As an administrator, I want the server to have at least 500MB of free disk space even when the IDE is installed, so that it keeps running.
technical_task: Ensure at least 500MB of free disk space on the server, with the IDE already installed.
acceptance_criteria: Given the IDE is installed on the server, when free disk space is checked, then at least 500MB is free.
Given free disk space below 500MB, when it is checked, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator.

requirement_text: A Data Publishing User shall be able to validate a CSV file before publishing.
user_story: As a data publisher, I want to validate a CSV file before publishing, so that errors are found early.
technical_task: Add a validation step for CSV files that runs before publishing.
acceptance_criteria: Given a CSV file, when the Data Publishing User validates it, then the file is checked and the result is reported.
Given a CSV file that failed validation, when the user tries to publish, then the user sees the validation problems first.
rationale: Role stated: Data Publishing User. The validation rules are not given; the second criterion is an assumption.

requirement_text: System shall provide detailed information on summits for user understanding.
user_story: As an attendee, I want detailed information about summits, so that I understand what each one offers.
technical_task: Show a detail page with information for each summit.
acceptance_criteria: Given a summit, when the user opens it, then detailed information about the summit is shown.
Given two summits, when the user opens each, then each shows its own information.
rationale: Role assumed: attendee. What information counts as detailed is not stated.

requirement_text: The user must fill in the required fields—User Name and Display Name—in the User Information section at the time of creating/adding a new user.
user_story: As an administrator, I want User Name and Display Name to be required when I add a new user, so that every user has both.
technical_task: Make User Name and Display Name required fields in the User Information section when a user is created.
acceptance_criteria: Given the User Information section, when the administrator leaves User Name or Display Name empty and saves, then the user is not created.
Given the User Information section, when the administrator fills in both fields and saves, then the user is created.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator.

requirement_text: During these corrections, the maximum azimuth alignment deviation signalized on bus must not be greater than before correction, with the exception that the maximum azimuth alignment deviation after compensation is verified to be larger.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the maximum azimuth alignment deviation signalized on the bus not to be greater during the corrections than before them, so that corrections do not make alignment worse.
technical_task: Keep the maximum azimuth alignment deviation signalized on the bus from exceeding its value before correction during the corrections, except where the deviation after compensation is verified to be larger.
acceptance_criteria: Given a correction is running, when the maximum azimuth alignment deviation on the bus is read, then it is not greater than before the correction.
Given the deviation after compensation is verified to be larger, when it is evaluated, then this is accepted as the stated exception.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer.

requirement_text: User shall be able to delete a chemist/lab, only if no new prescription is pending.
user_story: As a user, I want to delete a chemist or lab only when no new prescription is pending, so that no prescription is left without one.
technical_task: Allow deletion of a chemist/lab only if it has no new prescription pending.
acceptance_criteria: Given a chemist/lab with no new prescription pending, when the user deletes it, then it is deleted.
Given a chemist/lab with a new prescription pending, when the user tries to delete it, then the deletion is not allowed.
rationale: Role assumed: user.

requirement_text: User shall be able to pay bills by choosing payment options, selecting bill type (water, apartment, electricity), and entering the amount to make the payment.
user_story: As a resident, I want to pay bills by choosing a payment option, a bill type and an amount, so that I can settle water, apartment and electricity bills.
technical_task: Build a bill payment flow with payment option selection, a bill type choice of water, apartment or electricity, and amount entry.
acceptance_criteria: Given the bill payment screen, when the user selects a bill type, then water, apartment and electricity are offered.
Given a chosen payment option and bill type, when the user enters an amount and confirms, then the payment is made.
rationale: Role assumed: resident.

requirement_text: System shall be available at all times, with downtime limited to server maintenance.
user_story: As a user, I want the system available at all times, with downtime only for server maintenance, so that I can rely on it.
technical_task: Keep the system available continuously and limit downtime to server maintenance windows.
acceptance_criteria: Given normal operation, when a user opens the system, then it is available.
Given downtime occurs, when its cause is checked, then it was for server maintenance.
rationale: Role assumed: user. No availability percentage is given.

requirement_text: User shall be able to mark suspicious emails as spam by clicking on the spam button.
user_story: As an email user, I want to mark suspicious emails as spam with the spam button, so that they are filtered out.
technical_task: Add a spam button that marks a selected email as spam.
acceptance_criteria: Given a suspicious email, when the user clicks the spam button, then the email is marked as spam.
Given an email marked as spam, when the user views the inbox, then the email is no longer shown in it.
rationale: Role assumed: email user. The second criterion is an interpretation of marking as spam.

requirement_text: User shall access the system 24/7, with planned maintenance during off-peak hours.
user_story: As a user, I want to access the system 24/7, with planned maintenance in off-peak hours, so that I can use it whenever I need.
technical_task: Run the system around the clock and schedule planned maintenance for off-peak hours.
acceptance_criteria: Given any time of day, when a user opens the system, then it is accessible.
Given planned maintenance, when it is scheduled, then it takes place during off-peak hours.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Off-peak hours are not defined.

requirement_text: The details concerning EROTAN have to be implemented according to the EROTAN chapter of AV OBDAL [DI-1130].
rationale: The sentence points to another document for its content.
clarification_questions: Which parts of the referenced chapter apply?

requirement_text: The course details shall include title, description, price, duration, instructor information, and enrollment details.
user_story: As a student, I want course details to include the title, description, price, duration, instructor information and enrollment details, so that I can choose a course.
technical_task: Include title, description, price, duration, instructor information and enrollment details in each course's details.
acceptance_criteria: Given a course, when the user opens its details, then the title, description, price and duration are shown.
Given a course, when the user opens its details, then the instructor information and enrollment details are shown.
rationale: Role assumed: student.

requirement_text: It does not define protocol, interconnect, or connector details because these details are application-specific.
rationale: The sentence states what is not defined and gives no behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a note on scope?

requirement_text: User shall be able to tweet a certain topic.
user_story: As a social media user, I want to tweet about a certain topic, so that I can share my views.
technical_task: Offer a tweet function for posting on a chosen topic.
acceptance_criteria: Given a topic, when the user composes a tweet about it, then the tweet is posted.
Given a posted tweet, when it is viewed, then it shows the topic.
rationale: Role assumed: social media user. "Certain topic" is read as a topic the user picks.

requirement_text: (C) Record the encryption status (enabled or disabled) of electronic health information locally stored on end-user devices by EHR technology in accordance with the standard specified in § 170.210(e)(3) unless the EHR technology prevents electronic health information from being locally stored on end-user devices (see 170.314(d)(7) of this section).
user_story: As a compliance officer, I want the encryption status of locally stored electronic health information on end-user devices recorded, so that I know whether data is protected.
technical_task: Record whether electronic health information stored locally on end-user devices is encrypted, per the standard in 170.210(e)(3), unless the EHR technology prevents local storage (see 170.314(d)(7)).
acceptance_criteria: Given electronic health information stored locally on an end-user device, when it is stored, then its encryption status (enabled or disabled) is recorded.
Given EHR technology that prevents local storage of electronic health information, when the requirement is applied, then no encryption status needs to be recorded.
rationale: Role assumed: compliance officer. The standard is only referenced; the section symbol in the source is garbled.

requirement_text: The system shall be designed to facilitate future evolution and maintenance operations.
rationale: "Facilitate future evolution and maintenance" is not measurable.
clarification_questions: What kinds of future evolution must the system accommodate?
How is ease of maintenance verified?

requirement_text: The ISYNC procedure shall terminate when all 5 NEs are synchronized, four NEs are synchronized (when only four NEs are powered), or after the time-out period.
requirement_text_raw: The ISYNC procedure shall (3.2.2.3.4) terminate when all 5 NEs are synchronized, four NEs are synchronized (when only four NEs are powered), or after the time-out period.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the ISYNC procedure to end when all 5 NEs are synchronized, when four NEs are synchronized and only four are powered, or when the time-out period passes, so that synchronization does not hang.
technical_task: End the ISYNC procedure when all 5 NEs are synchronized, when four NEs are synchronized and only four are powered, or when the time-out period ends.
acceptance_criteria: Given all 5 NEs are synchronized, when ISYNC checks, then the procedure terminates.
Given only four NEs are powered and all four are synchronized, when ISYNC checks, then the procedure terminates.
Given the time-out period has passed, when ISYNC checks, then the procedure terminates.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer.

requirement_text: The system shall provide emergency communication options, including an emergency phone inside and outside the cabin.
user_story: As a passenger, I want emergency communication options, including an emergency phone inside and outside the cabin, so that I can call for help.
technical_task: Provide emergency communication, including an emergency phone inside the cabin and one outside it.
acceptance_criteria: Given the cabin, when it is inspected, then an emergency phone is available inside it.
Given the area outside the cabin, when it is inspected, then an emergency phone is available there.
rationale: Role assumed: passenger.

requirement_text: User shall have a view showing all attendee information attached to their training node, so trainers can see class attendance.
user_story: As a trainer, I want a view of all attendee information attached to my training node, so that I can see class attendance.
technical_task: Provide a view that shows all attendee information linked to the user's training node.
acceptance_criteria: Given attendees attached to a training node, when the trainer opens the view, then all their information is shown.
Given an attendee not attached to that node, when the trainer opens the view, then the attendee is not shown.
rationale: Role assumed: trainer.

requirement_text: Only authorized workers will be able to access the administrative panel.
user_story: As an administrator, I want only authorized workers to access the administrative panel, so that settings are protected.
technical_task: Restrict the administrative panel to authorized workers.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authorized worker, when the worker opens the administrative panel, then access is granted.
Given a user who is not an authorized worker, when the user opens the administrative panel, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator.

requirement_text: System shall restrict access to modules based on user roles, preventing students from updating marks.
user_story: As a school administrator, I want module access restricted by user role, so that students cannot update marks.
technical_task: Apply role-based access control to modules, denying students the ability to update marks.
acceptance_criteria: Given a student, when the student tries to update marks, then the update is not allowed.
Given a user whose role permits it, when the user opens a module, then access is granted.
rationale: Role assumed: school administrator.

requirement_text: An FAQ page shall be provided in Webble to explain terms, functionality, and other relevant information.
user_story: As a new user of Webble, I want an FAQ page explaining terms, functionality and other relevant information, so that I can learn how it works.
technical_task: Add an FAQ page to Webble covering terms, functionality and other relevant information.
acceptance_criteria: Given Webble, when a user opens the FAQ page, then it explains terms and functionality.
Given the FAQ page, when a user reads it, then other relevant information is included.
rationale: Role assumed: new user of Webble.

requirement_text: The contractor shall be prepared that the client has the right to require additionally some special solutions for programming persistent ECU memories (e.g., for updating navigation maps).
user_story: As a contractor, I want to be prepared for the client to require additional special solutions for programming persistent ECU memories, so that I can deliver them when asked.
technical_task: Prepare to supply special solutions for programming persistent ECU memories on request, for example for updating navigation maps.
acceptance_criteria: Given the client requires an additional special solution for programming persistent ECU memories, when the request is made, then the contractor is able to provide it.
Given an update of navigation maps is requested, when it is handled, then it is treated as an example of such a solution.
rationale: Role assumed: contractor. The solutions are not specified.

requirement_text: System shall provide error handling and logging to identify and communicate import errors effectively.
user_story: As an administrator, I want error handling and logging for import errors, so that I can find and report problems.
technical_task: Add error handling and logging for imports that identify errors and report them to the user.
acceptance_criteria: Given an import with an error, when the import runs, then the error is identified and logged.
Given an import error, when the import ends, then the error is communicated to the user.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. "Effectively" is not measured.

requirement_text: Once payment has been billed and received from secondary insurance it can be entered in the same way.
requirement_text_raw: Once payment has been billed and received from secondary insurance  it can be entered in the same way.
user_story: As a billing clerk, I want to enter payment received from secondary insurance the same way as other payments, so that billing is consistent.
technical_task: Allow payment billed and received from secondary insurance to be entered using the same procedure as the earlier payment entry.
acceptance_criteria: Given payment received from secondary insurance, when the clerk enters it, then it is entered in the same way as the earlier payment.
Given the payment has been entered, when the account is viewed, then it is recorded against the account.
rationale: Role assumed: billing clerk. "The same way" refers to a procedure described elsewhere.

requirement_text: While BCMChrgRq greater than 0 for longer than 5 seconds the signal ends.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the signal to end while BCMChrgRq stays greater than 0 for longer than 5 seconds, so that the request does not run on.
technical_task: End the signal when BCMChrgRq has been greater than 0 for longer than 5 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given BCMChrgRq is greater than 0, when it stays so for longer than 5 seconds, then the signal ends.
Given BCMChrgRq is greater than 0, when it has done so for 5 seconds or less, then the signal does not end.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer.

requirement_text: The system shall restrict the field to accept only numeric data entry.
user_story: As a user, I want the field to accept only numeric data, so that I cannot enter text by mistake.
technical_task: Restrict the field so only numeric characters are accepted.
acceptance_criteria: Given the field, when the user enters numeric data, then it is accepted.
Given the field, when the user enters non-numeric data, then it is rejected.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Which field is meant is not named.

requirement_text: The solution should enforce the most restrictive set of rights or privileges or accesses needed by users (or processes acting on behalf of users) for the performance of specified tasks.
user_story: As a security officer, I want users and processes acting for them to have only the most restrictive rights needed for their tasks, so that access is minimal.
technical_task: Enforce least privilege: grant users, and processes acting on their behalf, only the rights, privileges and accesses needed for the specified tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with a specified task, when rights are assigned, then only those needed for the task are granted.
Given a process acting on behalf of a user, when it runs, then it has no more rights than the task requires.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer.

requirement_text: The user interface should prioritize simplicity and avoid cluttering with excessive information to enhance usability.
rationale: "Simplicity" and "excessive" are subjective and not measurable.
clarification_questions: What does "simplicity" mean in measurable terms?

requirement_text: System shall enable users to view their signed-up summits for confirmation.
user_story: As an attendee, I want to view the summits I signed up for, so that I can confirm my registration.
technical_task: Show the signed-up summits of the user for confirmation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user signed up for summits, when the user opens their summits, then those summits are listed.
Given a user who has signed up for no summits, when the user opens the list, then it is empty.
rationale: Role assumed: attendee.

requirement_text: The system shall monitor timeliness of messages and alert users if certain time limits have been exceeded.
user_story: As a clinician, I want the system to monitor how timely messages are and alert me when certain time limits are exceeded, so that delayed messages are noticed.
technical_task: Monitor message timeliness and send an alert to users when time limits are exceeded.
acceptance_criteria: Given a message awaiting action, when a time limit is exceeded, then users are alerted.
Given a message handled within its time limit, when it is monitored, then no alert is raised.
rationale: Role assumed: clinician. The time limits are not stated.

requirement_text: The system shall be designed for easy maintenance to quickly address any errors that occur in the project.
rationale: "Easy" and "quickly" are not measurable.
clarification_questions: What makes maintenance "easy", and what is "quickly"?
Which errors does the requirement cover?

requirement_text: User shall be able to access detailed context-sensitive help material for all actions and scenarios.
user_story: As a user, I want detailed context-sensitive help for all actions and scenarios, so that I can learn what to do at each point.
technical_task: Provide help material specific to the current action or scenario.
acceptance_criteria: Given any action, when the user asks for help, then help material for that action is shown.
Given any scenario, when the user asks for help, then help material for that scenario is shown.
rationale: Role assumed: user.

requirement_text: User shall save the dividend released by each company for client information.
user_story: As a broker, I want to save the dividend released by each company, so that I can give clients this information.
technical_task: Store the dividend released by each company so it can be shown to clients.
acceptance_criteria: Given a company that releases a dividend, when the user saves it, then the dividend is stored for that company.
Given a stored dividend, when client information is prepared, then the dividend is available.
rationale: Role assumed: broker.

requirement_text: The system shall enforce data privacy and confidentiality measures to protect sensitive information handled within the command-line interface.
user_story: As a security officer, I want privacy and confidentiality measures for sensitive information handled in the command-line interface, so that data is protected.
technical_task: Apply data privacy and confidentiality controls to sensitive information used in the command-line interface.
acceptance_criteria: Given sensitive information is handled in the command-line interface, when it is displayed, then confidentiality measures are applied.
Given sensitive information in the command-line interface, when an unauthorized person tries to access it, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. The measures are not listed.

requirement_text: The Patient requests the closest hospitals so that only nearby hospitals are presented.
user_story: As a patient, I want to request the closest hospitals, so that only nearby hospitals are presented.
technical_task: Return only the closest hospitals when a patient requests hospitals.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient's location, when the patient requests hospitals, then the closest hospitals are presented.
Given a hospital that is far away, when the patient requests hospitals, then it is not presented.
rationale: Role stated: patient. "Closest" is not defined as a distance.

requirement_text: For details about video processing and transmission see "System Specification Telematic5STAR1 HU Entry Video Processing and Transmission" .
requirement_text_raw: For details about video processing and transmission see "System Specification Telematic5STAR1 HU Entry Video Processing and Transmission" [RD3649].
rationale: The sentence only points to another document.
clarification_questions: What does the referenced specification say about video processing and transmission?
Is the referenced document part of this requirement?

requirement_text: The system shall prompt customer with friend easy to read error messages.
rationale: The wording is unclear ("friend easy") and readability is not measurable.
clarification_questions: What does "friend easy to read" mean?
Which error messages are meant, and for which errors?

requirement_text: System shall display collection-level replication status.
user_story: As a repository manager, I want to see the collection-level replication status, so that I know whether collections are replicated.
technical_task: Display replication status at the collection level.
acceptance_criteria: Given a collection, when the user views it, then its replication status is displayed.
Given two collections with different replication states, when each is viewed, then each shows its own status.
rationale: Role assumed: repository manager.

requirement_text: The system shall be capable of responding in a loss-less manner to I/O and processing changes arising from Correlator mode changes.
user_story: As an observatory engineer, I want the system to respond without losing data to I/O and processing changes caused by Correlator mode changes, so that observations are not corrupted.
technical_task: Handle I/O and processing changes triggered by Correlator mode changes without loss of data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Correlator mode change, when I/O changes occur, then the system responds without data loss.
Given a Correlator mode change, when processing changes occur, then the system responds without data loss.
rationale: Role assumed: observatory engineer.

requirement_text: System shall verify user input from the database and proceed accordingly, logging the user into the home page.
user_story: As a user, I want my input verified against the database and to be logged in to the home page when it is correct, so that I reach my account.
technical_task: Check the user's input against the database and, if it matches, log the user in and show the home page.
acceptance_criteria: Given input that matches the database, when the user submits it, then the user is logged in to the home page.
Given input that does not match the database, when the user submits it, then the user is not logged in.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Proceed accordingly" is read as continuing to the home page on success.
